title: Sort Transformed Array
description: Given a sorted array and a quadratic function f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c, return the array sorted in non-decreasing order.

steps.note: Initialize pointers and index. Since a < 0, fill from left (0).
Since v1 < v2, place v1 at res[0] and increment i.
Final element v2 is 3, place at res[1].
